verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop app for working with a coding agent through per-chat sessions and a composer. The agent carries out git and PR operations itself, so the product is operated by conversing with the agent. missing for 10: explicit documentation that commands are given in natural language (it is only implied by the chat/composer model), and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well natural-language instructions are followed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: omnirush.ai is a desktop app for working with a coding agent on your own projects.
Choose a model and an effort level (low, high, xhigh, max) per chat.
The agent clones, branches, creates worktrees, commits, pushes, and opens and reviews pull requests with `gh`.
The composer's full-permissions toggle switches between asking and allowing every tool call.
